newsitem.title: USA: Bear Stearns says ups Venezuela to overweight.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns says ups Venezuela to overweight.

text.p: Bear Stearns said on Tuesday it raised Venezuela to overweight from neutral in its Latin American Model Portfolio, citing privatization and improvement in the country's economy expected in 1997.

Analysts Geoffrey Dennis and Julie Dykstra said in a research note the upgrade was due to a rally in anticipation of the sale of telephone company CANTV, 40 percent of which is due to be sold in a November global offering.

The longer-term reason was the view that "the performance of the Venezuelan economy is set to improve significantly in 1997, based on reforms introduced this year and the current direction of economic policy."
